why: db12 cold-open selected was 1.30e-3 s after a parallel touch of every page at open, slower than db11 7.42e-4 s and behind ASE 1.16e-3 s. Selected cold stayed bimodal at IQR/median 0.461 with POSIX_FADV_RANDOM.
chosen: Warm opens use readahead(2) and no threads. The cold open reads the whole file under 1 MiB with one pread before it returns, so the query does not fault a hole. The harness was not changed.
